content: Google TV Freeplay, the company’s free, ad-supported streaming service, now supports video on demand. Instead of tuning into Google TV Freeplay’s selection of always-on channels, you can now choose from over 10,000 shows and movies to watch whenever you want. The update introduces titles like Lady Bird, Seventeen Again, and Hell’s Kitchen, according to Google’s announcement. The company has also expanded its live TV lineup to include more than 300 channels dedicated to news, sports, reality TV, true crime, and more. Some of these new channels include World of Love Island, Yahoo! Sports Network, Bloomberg TV Plus, and The Martha Stewart Channel. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/tv-freeplay.webp?quality=90&strip=all] Free and ultra-cheap streaming is on the rise as major streamers continue to raise their prices. Google TV Freeplay joins Tubi, The Roku Channel, and Pluto TV in offering free, ad-supported content on demand, while Disney Plus is considering launching a free streaming tier as well. Google says it plans to continue updating its Freeplay library throughout the year.

chineseContent: Google TV Freeplay 是该公司免费的、支持广告的流媒体服务，现在支持视频点播。您现在可以从 10,000 多个节目和电影中进行选择，以便随时观看，而无需收听 Google TV Freeplay 精选的始终在线频道。根据谷歌的公告，此次更新引入了《伯德小姐》、《重返十七岁》和《地狱厨房》等游戏。该公司还扩大了直播电视阵容，包括 300 多个专门针对新闻、体育、真人秀、真实犯罪等的频道。其中一些新频道包括 World of Love Island、Yahoo!体育网、彭博电视+和玛莎·斯图尔特频道。 [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/tv-freeplay.webp?quality=90&strip=all] 随着主要流媒体继续提高价格，免费和超便宜的流媒体正在增加。 Google TV Freeplay 与 Tubi、Roku Channel 和 Pluto TV 一起提供免费的、广告支持的点播内容，而 Disney Plus 也正在考虑推出免费的流媒体服务。谷歌表示，计划全年继续更新其 Freeplay 库。
